description:
Manage your IDEs the easy way.

Open any of your projects in any of the IDEs with one click.
What's New in Toolbox App 3.8.1 Bugfix Update
Fixed loading the SSH Tools tab. TBX-19252
What's New in Toolbox App 3.8
IDE updates on macOS
macOS was sometimes incorrectly reporting an IDE installation directory as non-writable, causing the Toolbox App to needlessly disable an update that would have otherwise succeeded.
The Toolbox App now keeps these updates available for manual installation. If macOS blocks an update, the app shows instructions for resolving the issue. TBX-10297
Keyboard navigation
On Windows, you can use the Ctrl+1 and Ctrl+2 shortcuts to switch between the Tools and Projects tabs. TBX-19029
You can again use the Up Arrow and Down Arrow keys to move through project and tool lists. The Toolbox App also handles Page Up, Page Down, Home, and End as expected. TBX-15385
Leftover-directory cleanup
While deleting leftover IDE directories, the Toolbox App now shows progress and disables the related delete controls until cleanup finishes. TBX-9661
See the full list of release notes here
